# PigmentaLab MCP

> Hosted pre-press engine for DTF and textile printing, usable from any AI agent through MCP or a REST API: check
> whether an image prints well at a size, remove backgrounds, upscale, halftone, knock out a color and lay designs out
> on a gang sheet. Works in any language.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/bykarlos/pigmentalab-mcp/blob/main/README.md): connect from Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Gemini CLI; tools and prices
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/bykarlos/pigmentalab-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an agent should use PigmentaLab
- [The DTF print-prep skill](https://github.com/bykarlos/pigmentalab-mcp/blob/main/plugins/pigmentalab/skills/dtf-print-prep/SKILL.md)
- [REST examples](https://github.com/bykarlos/pigmentalab-mcp/tree/main/examples): curl, Python and Node

## Service

- MCP server: https://mcp.pigmentalab.io/mcp (Streamable HTTP; OAuth 2.1 or X-API-Key)
- REST API: https://api.pigmentalab.io/v1 · OpenAPI: https://pigmentalab.io/mcp/openapi.json
- Prices: https://api.pigmentalab.io/v1/pricing
- How to authenticate: https://pigmentalab.io/auth.md
- Guide: https://pigmentalab.io/mcp · Site index for LLMs: https://pigmentalab.io/llms.txt
